questions.q: Name the five steps of nutrition in animals.
questions.a: Ingestion, digestion, absorption, assimilation and egestion.

questions.q: Where does digestion of food begin in humans?
questions.a: In the mouth - teeth break food and saliva starts digesting starch.

questions.q: What is the role of the stomach in digestion?
questions.a: Its acid and juices churn food and digest proteins into simpler forms.

questions.q: Write the word equation of respiration.
questions.a: Food (glucose) + oxygen -> carbon dioxide + water + energy.

questions.q: Why do we breathe faster while running?
questions.a: Running muscles need more energy, so more oxygen must be taken in quickly.

questions.q: Which organs take in oxygen in humans?
questions.a: The lungs - oxygen passes from air sacs into the blood.

questions.q: What happens to the diaphragm when we inhale?
questions.a: It flattens and moves down, making chest space bigger so air rushes into the lungs.

questions.q: Name the windpipe that carries air to the lungs.
questions.a: The trachea, which divides into two bronchi.

questions.q: What are the air sacs in the lungs called?
questions.a: Alveoli - tiny sacs where oxygen enters the blood.

questions.q: What does the circulatory system carry around the body?
questions.a: Blood carrying oxygen, food, wastes and hormones to and from every cell.

questions.q: Name the vessels that carry blood back to the heart.
questions.a: Veins (arteries carry blood away from the heart).
